name: rxatlas
description: US drug products at FDA product-NDC grain, with per-field provenance: search drug records, fetch one record in full, resolve records by identifier and read coverage. Keyless clients are answered from a published evaluation sample, rate-limited per IP; full access is available with a bearer token or per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: drugs_search
tools.description: Search drug records by name, ingredient or other attributes.

tools.name: drugs_get
tools.description: Fetch one drug record in full, including its per-field provenance.

tools.name: drugs_lookup_by_ids
tools.description: Resolve drug records by external identifiers.

tools.name: drugs_coverage
tools.description: Read the live coverage of the drug dataset.
